chunks: Hammad narrated from Hariz from Zurara who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): 'Is the Takbir during the Days of Tashriq after the obligatory prayers?' He said: 'The Takbir is in Mina after fifteen prayers, and in the other cities after ten prayers. So the first Takbir is after the Dhuhr prayer on the Day of Nahr (Sacrifice),' and he continued the hadith.

key_terms.أَيَّامَ التَّشْرِيقِ: Days of Tashriq (the 11th, 12th, and 13th of Dhu al-Hijjah)

ai.seo_question: How many prayers are followed by the Takbir during the Days of Tashriq in Mina versus other cities?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Istibsar establishes the specific ritual protocol for the Takbir al-Tashriq, distinguishing between the sacred precincts of Mina (fifteen prayers) and other cities (ten prayers), commencing after Dhuhr on the 10th of Dhu al-Hijjah. It reflects the Shia jurisprudential emphasis on precise timing and location in acts of worship, linking the remembrance of God directly to the completion of the Hajj rituals. The narration underscores the communal aspect of this declaration, reinforcing the unity of the believers during the festive days following Eid al-Adha.
